purpose: Bind how the historical R7.5.4 action/sizing evidence may be transferred to the SPNNIV3 H2/H3 representation program before the H2-vs-H3 strategic winner is known.

historical_provenance.binding_finding: Historical R7.5.4 strategic action-abstraction evidence was generated under the then-selected R7.5.3 neural representation and therefore is not, by itself, strategic sufficiency evidence for SPNNIV3 H2 or H3.

phase2_fixed_control.meaning: This is the fixed action abstraction under which H2-vs-H3 Phase2 representation selection is evaluated. Phase2 does not establish global action-abstraction optimality.

winner_independent_transfer_rule.provisional_representation: Whichever of H2_RELATIONAL_EXACT_STRUCTURED_HISTORY_FINAL or H3_HYBRID_EXACT_SEMANTIC_FINAL is selected by the already-frozen Phase2 representation protocol; BLOCKED remains BLOCKED.

scope: C++ exact legal action set -> universal resolver/dedup -> collector -> reservoir target -> neural action slot/mask -> AveragePolicy -> runtime action identity
exact raise-to and call-chip geometry parity
no duplicate exact action aliases after resolution
structural_transfer_gate.meaning: Passing this gate proves representation/action plumbing compatibility only; it does not prove 33/75/AI is strategically sufficient.

strategic_revalidation.inheritance_rule: Re-run the historical R7.5.4A then R7.5.4B protocol under the provisional SPNNIV3 representation without changing candidate set, metric direction, thresholds, roots, seeds, bootstrap counts, dense-referee role, or selection cascade.

representation_action_interaction_rule.if_final_action_selection_equals_phase2_: The Phase2 H2-vs-H3 representation comparison remains action-compatible, subject to all other admission gates.
representation_action_interaction_rule.if_postflop_or_preflop_selection_changes: Reopen representation admission and repeat the frozen H2-vs-H3 strategic comparison under the newly selected action abstraction before any production representation freeze.
representation_action_interaction_rule.reason: A representation winner measured under PF0/PR0 cannot be assumed invariant to a materially changed action space.

forbidden_after_output_changes: using the eventual H2/H3 winner to tailor the action protocol
